purpose: Decide whether a post-29953, single-L20 result justifies designing a candidate selector before renting any second GPU
toolchain: CUDA toolkit 13.0.88, architecture 89, exact driver/compiler recorded
questions: Does the immediate pre-fix exact-allocation positive control reproduce a tail over-read, while the fixed exact-allocation run has zero errors and passes the same numerical cases?
On the fixed source, is dense n8 on 8B materially faster with MMQ at 810 MHz?
Does the winner change in the same session with the graphics clock reset to the device default?
Does the 1B Q8_0 negative/control workload still prevent a blanket rule?

admission.coverage: Q4_0/Q8_0 x n2..8 x 12 attention/FFN shapes; no full-model correctness or MoE acceptance
admission.parent_force_exact: Required positive control: memcheck error-exitcode 99, Invalid __global__ read, numerical 168/168
admission.fixed_force_exact: Required memcheck zero errors plus numerical 168/168; exact cudaMalloc pool; CUDA Graph OFF
admission.on_failure: Preserve logs and STOP; no exploratory bypass

clock_conditions: device default after reset; record achieved clocks, do not assume 2520 MHz
timing.memory_clock: do not change; record actual clocks; >1% change between conditions makes frequency attribution inconclusive
timing.order: alternate clock-condition order by round; rotate 3 worlds and 3 files by round; n8 in its own invocation
timing.controls: n1 and n16 must route identically; null_rebuild is an independent same-source rebuild
timing.telemetry: 100 ms invocation-wide samples; n8 invocation includes its load/warmup but excludes n1/n16 measurements
timing.timeout: 60 minutes for timing; preserve incomplete run on expiry

analysis.unit: six outer rounds, not 100 inner repetitions
analysis.estimate: paired geometric mean and 95% percentile bootstrap, Random(0), 10000 resamples
analysis.pilot_noise_floor: max |paired_gm(null_rebuild/selected)-1| over n={1,8,16}; different from the old full-sweep n2..8 definition
analysis.control_quality: pilot null floor and max cutoff7/selected deviation at n1/n16 must both be <=2%
analysis.material_win: ratio >=1+max(3%, pilot null floor, route control deviation), CI lower >1+floor, at least 5/6 paired wins
analysis.material_loss: symmetric negative condition with at most 1/6 wins
analysis.low_clock_quality: at least 90% busy samples within 810 +/-15 MHz in each n8 invocation
analysis.frequency_separation: default achieved mean >=1.5x low condition for each file and world
analysis.go: passing safety/admission, valid controls/telemetry, and at least one material 8B win: review a concrete candidate rule before any second GPU
analysis.no_go: valid run but no material 8B win: stop expanding; document result
analysis.inconclusive: safety, controls, telemetry, download or build failure: diagnose with this machine; do not buy another GPU

limitations: One GPU cannot establish a portable selection rule
Default clocks can differ between algorithms; compare telemetry before causal claims
Historical b968 measurements are context only; current-source tests cannot isolate #29953 from all changes since b968
Passing this focused gate is not full regression, full-model numerical acceptance, or a mergeable optimization PR
spending: One device only; check admission before long runs; initial 2-3h working allowance is an estimate, not measured runtime or prepaid commitment; review elapsed cost at 60 min
